research.searchCoverage: Official Callingly API documentation, authentication, teams/leads/calls endpoints, Arizona/US company identity, and dated security/incident search reviewed on 2026-09-13. No qualifying current unresolved Callingly compromise found in reviewed coverage, without a breach-free claim.

Official Callingly REST API at https://api.callingly.com uses Authorization Bearer tokens created under Settings > API Keys. Operator is Callingly, headquartered in Scottsdale/Phoenix, Arizona, United States; international lead-response product, not a mainland-China edition. Dated incident search on 2026-09-13 found no qualifying current unresolved Callingly compromise after distinguishing Callagy Law, Calligaris, and Callaway incidents.

incidents.finding: Bounded search of Callingly security breach and incident coverage on 2026-09-13 identified no current unresolved customer-data compromise.
incidents.limitation: This is not a breach-free claim; live authentication remains unverified.

research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck maps to documented GET /v1/teams, matching the pinned validator. Create-call, SMS, lead mutation, and other writes are omitted.
Native category is messaging: Callingly is a lead-response calling/SMS API. Source Communication/Productivity are not in the Rust CATEGORIES allowlist.
Official docs and pinned source agree on https://api.callingly.com, Authorization Bearer, and Accept: application/json. The upstream user-agent is not sent.
Returns raw Callingly JSON under data. Official list-teams is a JSON array. Optional accountId is sent as account_id for agency-scoped client accounts.
teamId is a required positive integer path segment on GET /v1/teams/{id}.
Returns raw Callingly JSON under data. Official list-leads is a JSON array. Optional start, end, phone_number, and accountId (as account_id) use official/source query names.
leadId is a required positive integer path segment on GET /v1/leads/{id}.
POST /v1/teams creates a team; preserves raw Callingly JSON under data.
DELETE /v1/leads/{id} deletes a lead; empty bodies map to deleted=true.
GET /v1/calls lists calls with optional start/end/team_id/limit/page.
POST /v1/calls creates an outbound call for a lead.
